title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription: About The Job: As a Web Analytics Engineer, you will be part of the Platform Analytics team, partnering with multiple cross-functional teams to support and extend Adobe Marketing Cloud technology across our global marketing programs. In this role, you will help deploy and maintain scalable combinations of process, and technology to ensure best practices in data quality, data availability, data privacy compliance, digital analytics implementations and tag management. This is a fast-paced environment where you will manage multiple projects simultaneously and collaborate with stakeholders across the company. To thrive here, you should be eager to stay up to date on industry and technology trends, write detailed technical documentation, troubleshoot complex issues, and continuously enhance our marketing infrastructure. What you will do: Tag Management & Integration: Implement and perform quality assurance (QA) of various integrations within Adobe Launch (including Google Ads, Linked In, X, etc.). Validation & Auditing: Perform rigorous validation of all code and tagging activities across both preproduction and production environments. Audit digital tags regularly to ensure accurate, efficient implementation and data integrity. Data Architecture: Determine the most effective, time-efficient, and cost-efficient methods for capturing data elements in web development using an events-driven data layer. Data Quality & Governance: Develop a data quality metrics framework, including dashboards, scorecards, and monitoring systems (alerts and triggers). Establish procedures, policies, and internal controls for detecting and correcting data quality issues. Data Stewardship: Serve as the subject matter expert and digital analytics data steward. Educate and support data end-users, explaining complex analytics implementations while ensuring data accessibility and quality. Compliance: Partner with site leads to maintain quarterly cookie scans, ensuring tags fire strictly based on their designated buckets for cookie consent compliance. Strategy & Documentation: Support a multi-domain web personalization team and overall optimization strategy, maintain a multi-year roadmap, and manage a prioritized backlog of work. Technical Authoring: Maintain the Solution Design Reference (SDR) and develop detailed technical documentation, including user stories, data flow diagrams, entity relationship diagrams, user guides, test cases, and internal blog posts. What you will bring: Technical Expertise: Strong experience working with Adobe Marketing Cloud technology (specifically Adobe Launch/Data Collection) and maintaining a Solution Design Reference (SDR). Knowledge of Javascript is required. Data Layer Knowledge: Solid understanding of web development data capture, specifically utilizing an events-driven data layer. QA & Testing Skills: Proven track record of validating code, tag auditing, and troubleshooting analytics implementations across preproduction and production environments. Privacy & Compliance Awareness: Familiarity with global data privacy laws, cookie consent compliance management, and executing cookie scans. Documentation & Communication: Exceptional ability to write detailed technical documentation (e.g., data flow diagrams, user stories, test cases) and translate complex analytics concepts for non-technical stakeholders. The following are considered a plus: Experience building data quality metrics frameworks from scratch, including automated alerts, triggers, and data health scorecards. Direct experience supporting multi-domain web personalization and optimization conversion strategies. Experience writing internal technical blog posts, enablement guides, or training materials to foster data-driven awareness across an organization. Previous experience working within global, enterprise-level marketing environments. Understanding of Typescript, CI/CD and Git. About Red Hat Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. Inclusion at Red Hat Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. title: Senior Architect
jobDescription: About The Job: A Senior Architect is able to act as a solution lead for small to medium sized teams delivering standard to complex solutions as well as influence Client Architects, technical individual contributors, and up to Director level (or equivalent) managers. They are accountable for having established expertise of process, concept, and technical knowledge in pre-sales and delivery. A Senior Architect is able to impact their region and has strong connections within teams outside of their career path. As a Senior Architect, you will lead the strategic design and implementation of Open Shift-based platforms that bridge the gap between traditional Dev Ops and modern MLOps. Your mission is to architect resilient, scalable environments that allow data scientists to move from "laptop to production" without the friction of infrastructure silos. You will be the primary advisor for clients navigating the complexities of GPU orchestration, Model Serving, and Hybrid Cloud AI. Note: This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws. What Will You Do: Open Shift Platform Engineering Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Design and automate the deployment of Open Shift clusters across hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, On-prem). Cluster Management: Implement Multi-Cluster Management using Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (ACM) and ensure security compliance via Advanced Cluster Security (ACS). Scaling & Optimization: Tune Open Shift for high-performance AI workloads, including specialized GPU node labeling, partitioning, and autoscaling. Open Shift AI & MLOps Orchestration AI Lifecycle Design: Architect the full AI lifecycle on Open Shift AI, integrating Jupyter Hub, Elyra pipelines, and internal model registries. Inference & Serving: Design high-concurrency model serving architectures using KServe, Caikit, and TGIS (Text Generation Inference Server) for LLMs. Instruct Lab Integration: Lead clients in using Instruct Lab on Open Shift to fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) with proprietary enterprise data. Strategic Consulting Sovereign AI Strategy: Advise regulated industry clients (Banking, Healthcare, Gov) on how to maintain data sovereignty while leveraging Generative AI. TCO Analysis: Help clients understand the Total Cost of Ownership of running AI on Open Shift vs. proprietary Saa S AI platforms. Developer Experience (Dev Ex): Create a seamless workflow for developers and data scientists, reducing "time-to-first-token." What Will You Bring: Consulting DNA: 15+ years in professional services with a knack for whiteboarding complex YAML-wrangling into a business-friendly vision. Red Hat Mastery: Proven track record of deploying Open Shift in production-grade, air-gapped, or highly regulated environments. AI/ML Fluency: Solid understanding of the AI development lifecycle—you don't need to be a Data Scientist, but you must speak "Data Science" fluently (embeddings, vector DBs, fine-tuning). Security Mindset: Expertise in RBAC, Network Policies, and "Shift Left" security within the Open Shift ecosystem. Certifications (The "Gold Standard") but not mandatory Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) – The ultimate validator. Red Hat Certified Specialist in Open Shift Automation and Management. Cloud-specific Architect certifications (AWS SAP, Azure Solutions Architect). title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription: About the Job The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team in Pune, India. In this role, you will work within an agile, globally distributed organization to design, build, and scale our next-generation open-source platforms and backend infrastructure using Python. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to implementing robust, high-performing features, ensuring code quality through automated testing pipelines, and actively collaborating with upstream open-source communities. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Product Management, and site reliability teams across time zones to solve complex, real-world technical challenges for enterprise deployments. What will you do Lead the technical design, implementation, and optimization of highly scalable and secure backend services primarily written in Python. Drive high-quality delivery within an Agile/Scrum framework by actively engaging in all team ceremonies and peer code reviews. Build, package, and deploy container-based applications targeting Red Hat Open Shift, Kubernetes, and major public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Architect and integrate automated testing frameworks, quality gates, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, logging, profiling) into CI/CD pipelines. Act as a point of escalation for complex bug resolution, utilizing deep root-cause analysis across integrated distributed environments. Engage with open-source community development models, occasionally contributing upstream fixes or participating in technology forums. Proactively leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development workflows, optimize code quality, and explore emerging automation patterns. What will you bring Experience: Typically requires 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field. Core Language: Strong expertise in Python software development, best practices, object-oriented design, and framework architectures (e.g., Fast API, Django, or Flask depending on domain focus). Linux & Containers: Hands-on experience with Linux distributions (RHEL, Cent OS Stream, Fedora) and containerization workflows (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes). CI/CD & Dev Ops: Demonstrated experience implementing and troubleshooting CI/CD infrastructure (Jenkins, Git Lab CI, Tekton) and automation workflows. System Design: Solid understanding of backend web infrastructure, REST/g RPC API patterns, database systems (SQL or No SQL), and distributed systems architecture. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze and interpret complex systems and workflows, with strong problem-solving and analytical skills and a keen attention to detail. Communication: Professional proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders. Mindset: A proactive, growth-oriented mindset dedicated to fostering a collaborative, transparent, and inclusive open-source team environment. Plus Skills (Nice to Have) Prior code contributions to upstream open-source communities or projects. title: Principal Information Systems Engineer
jobDescription:
Red Hat's DNS and Operating Systems (D/OS) team owns the foundational infrastructure layer the entire company runs on: DNS, Linux and Windows OS platforms, full-disk encryption, and access and bastion services. We serve everyone from engineering labs to global business operations, and we care about operational excellence, clean automation, and systems that work without heroics. Red Hat is an open source company, and that shapes how we operate
- decisions happen in the open, knowledge is shared, and the strongest technical argument wins regardless of title. We are looking for a Principal Information Systems Engineer who has gone deep in infrastructure and is now as comfortable setting direction as executing it. You will drive how our services evolve, work with team leadership to establish the technical standards the team works to, and serve as a credible technical voice with adjacent teams. The team will bring you up to speed on D/OS-specific tooling and institutional knowledge. What we need from you is the experience and ownership mindset to take real technical authority, ramp quickly, and help us improve our portfolio of offerings. What You Will Do? Partner with IT leadership and adjacent IT teams as the D/OS technical authority on shared infrastructure concerns. Own major services across the portfolio (DNS, Linux platform, automation, access services) and drive architectural decisions with documented trade-offs. Lead infrastructure changes from scoping through delivery, whether upgrades, migrations, or re-architecture. Define SLOs, close systemic reliability gaps, and lead post-mortems that produce durable fixes. Join the team's global on-call rotation as you ramp in; be a stabilizing presence during incidents. Grow senior engineers through design review, mentorship, and hands-on guidance; document decisions and operational knowledge to outlast any individual. What You Will Bring? Leadership & Mentorship: Demonstrated success growing senior engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and active mentorship. Operational & Architectural Strategy: Strong focus on designing, evolving, and sunsetting services rather than simple maintenance. Proven ability to define SLOs, eliminate toil, and articulate complex architectural trade-offs to stakeholders ranging from peers to leadership. Communication & Transparency: Commitment to transparent decision-making, thorough documentation, and precise asynchronous communication across global time zones. Technical Expertise: Deep experience operating RHEL at enterprise scale and building sophisticated automation with Ansible (playbooks, roles, AAP workflows, and execution environments). Infrastructure Proficiency: Extensive background managing core enterprise services such as DNS, DHCP/IPAM, and proxy/egress control (e.g., Infoblox, NS1, Satellite). Delivery & Pipelines: Experience managing CI/CD pipelines and Git Ops as first-class infrastructure, prioritizing versioning, testing, and service promotion. Ownership & Initiative: Highly self-directed with a record of identifying high-leverage opportunities, investigating system history prior to implementation, and ensuring all projects are production-ready, documented, and cleanly transitioned. jobDescription: About the Job : The Red Hat Enterprise Linux Engineering (RHEL) team is looking for a skilled and passionate developer with Linux experience and programming skills to join us as a Senior Software Engineer. In this role, you will focus on developing, deploying, integrating, and validating RHEL workloads on multiple public clouds. You will work in an environment where diverse perspectives are invited, the best ideas are valued, and people feel empowered to contribute. You will work as part of a distributed self-organizing team in close collaboration and regular communication with other team members and upstream developers, and will be at the forefront of our most exciting new initiatives. What You Will Do ? Participate in RHEL development developing features, root causing and fixing bugs including validation for multiple public clouds. Troubleshoot a diverse range of problems related to RHEL in cloud environments. Grow as a mature team player and lead new features/solutions from a technical perspective by collaborating with stakeholders. Participate in technical discussions, team brainstorming sessions, and planning to contribute to the next generation of features and innovations. Cooperate with other engineering teams across RHEL for joint-effort solutions or initiatives. Leverage AI-assisted development and/or validation tools and techniques to optimize day-to-day workflows. What You Will Bring ? 5+ years of software development experience with strong programming skills in C and Python. Direct experience in Linux development and a deep understanding of developing on Linux-based operating systems. Hands-on development and deployment experience with Major Public Clouds, specifically AWS, GCP, and Azure, regarding their underlying infrastructure and RHEL integration.
